Not locked: Plainphone is not Device Owner. Set the phone up with the QR code.
Maintenance unlock is active. The lock returns automatically.
Another operating system can be installed on this phone. Plainphone cannot guarantee the lock or protect the phone after a reset.
The phone’s security check found a problem with its system. The lock cannot be trusted.
Warning: the maintenance PIN is the default test PIN.
The PIN does not match. Try again.
All installation windows for today have been used. Try again tomorrow.

Open Settings, then Special app access and Alarms & reminders. Allow Plainphone.
This removes every restriction and gives up Device Owner. Plainphone can then be uninstalled and the phone reset normally. Continue?
Phone app: not Plainphone. Calls are not filtered.
SMS app: not Plainphone. Messages are not filtered.

resources.string: Approved contacts are not enforced right now (not locked, or maintenance unlock).
Make Plainphone the phone and SMS app, so calls and messages are limited to approved contacts.
No approved contacts yet. A parent can add them on the maintenance screen.
Only these people can call and text this phone. Emergency numbers such as 112 always work. Apps like WhatsApp and Signal are not covered by this list.
Some conversations are read-only. Existing picture and group messages appear as placeholders.
Your parent can review the names and numbers saved in this phone’s contacts.
Contact suggestions from this phone are off.
Favourites can call and text you during a schedule that limits calls and texts. You can reach them too.
This change is waiting for your key.
Could not change the favourite. Try again.
Message history could not be loaded.
Picture or group message. The contents cannot be displayed.
The message could not be sent. Your text is still here.
%1$s is not an approved contact, so messages cannot be sent.
Approved contacts and emergency numbers (112) only.
Only approved contacts can be called. Emergency numbers always work.
Plainphone is not allowed to make calls yet.
The call could not be started.
Only these numbers can call and text this phone, and be called and texted from it. Emergency numbers always work.
That is not a phone number. Use the country code, for example +45.
Ask your parent for a new setup QR code. Factory-reset this phone, then scan the new code during Android setup.
This setup link is out of date. Make a new one in the dashboard and open it on this phone.
Scan this code with the camera on the parent\'s phone. Or open app.plainphone.org, choose Add phone, then Type the code.
Waiting for the dashboard. The code is valid for 15 minutes.
Could not reach the server. Check the Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
Not paired with a parent yet.
Paired. Waiting for the first rules from the server.
Removed in the parent\'s dashboard. The last rules still apply. Pair again from the maintenance screen.
Switched off by a parent. Plainphone no longer locks this phone and can be uninstalled.
No rules from the server yet: the QR code\'s rules apply.
This list is managed in the parent\'s dashboard (app.plainphone.org). Change it there.
Closes apps your parent has not allowed, and apps whose time is up.

Plainphone checks which app is open so it can close apps that are blocked or out of time. To recognise pages where Plainphone can be switched off, it checks screen text and descriptions in Android settings and related system screens. It checks these on the phone and does not send them to the server. The phone can report minutes used for apps with a time limit.
Plainphone uses this so it has to be switched off here before it can be uninstalled.
With this on, Plainphone cannot simply be uninstalled. The parent is told if it is switched off.
Switching this off allows Plainphone to be uninstalled. Your parent can receive a notification.
Check that %1$s is your dashboard. Choose a parent PIN with 6 to 12 digits and enter it twice.
This phone is already set up. Open Plainphone to continue.
Getting your rules from the dashboard…
This phone was removed from the dashboard. Reconnect it from the dashboard.
In App info, choose Battery usage and turn on Allow background activity for Plainphone.
In App info, open Battery saver and choose No restrictions for Plainphone.
Add Plainphone to Never sleeping apps. You can find the list under Battery, then Background usage limits.
Get a new setup link from the dashboard and open it on this phone.
Check that the phone is online, then try again.
Setting up from the dashboard? Go back to Chrome and tap Open Plainphone on the setup page.
You need it to change Plainphone on this phone later. At least 6 digits. Keep it to yourself.
The two PINs are not the same.
Choose Plainphone to put your approved contacts in charge of who can call.
Choose Plainphone to send and receive texts with approved contacts.
Android calls it a VPN. It looks up web addresses through Plainphone to block some sites. Some content still gets through. No other traffic goes through it.
Open Plainphone in the list if needed, then allow it to see how long apps are used.
With this on, Plainphone cannot simply be removed. The parent is told if it is switched off.
Allow notifications and let Plainphone run in the background so protection stays on.
In App info, go to Permissions, then Location, and choose Allow all the time.
Allow precise location if you want to find this phone from the dashboard.
Open Plainphone guard in the list and switch it on to close apps you haven’t allowed.
Tap the gear next to Plainphone and switch on Always-on VPN. Leave \"Block connections without VPN\" off: Plainphone\'s filter only carries web addresses.
On the parent\'s phone, open app.plainphone.org and scan the code Plainphone shows next.
Plainphone now follows the parent\'s rules. Rules change from the parent\'s dashboard.
This app is not on your list
Ask your parent if you need it. They can allow it in Plainphone.
It opens again tomorrow. Calls and messages work as always.
Use the parent\'s PIN to change this setting.
This is not available right now
Go back to the start screen. You can always call or message a parent.
Some settings Plainphone uses to apply rules are off.
Install and add a Play account
This switches off the guard, the web filter and device admin, so Plainphone can be uninstalled. The parent is told. Continue?
Allow Plainphone to run in the background so it can update itself safely.
Version %1$s is ready. Tap to open the download.
Install Plainphone on your child’s phone. Use the dashboard to manage it from here.
Want to use your own phone less? Set up Plainphone for yourself.
A parent will manage which apps and websites this phone can use. Android will ask you to allow those protections during setup.
Set up protection on your own phone?
You choose what to limit on this phone. Stricter rules apply when your phone next connects. Looser rules wait for your key.
Android blocked this as a restricted setting. Follow these steps:
Open app.plainphone.org to connect your phone. Choose Myself in the dashboard, then check the account shown on this phone.
This link uses a different profile. Go back to change your choice, or cancel to use another link.
Wrong account? Use the maintenance PIN or release the phone from the dashboard.
Check the account before connecting this phone. Your saved PIN will still work.
Check that %1$s is your dashboard. Choose a PIN with 6 to 12 digits and enter it twice.
This makes it harder to remove Plainphone. Your dashboard will be notified if protection is switched off.
Plainphone now follows your rules. You can change them in your dashboard.
Plainphone is switching off. Your dashboard will update when the phone reconnects.
How long can you undo setup?
Choose how long you can switch Plainphone off after setup, without waiting or asking anyone. A dashboard choice for this phone takes precedence.
Stricter rules apply as soon as your phone connects. Loosening rules or removing Plainphone uses your key.
Your choice here replaces any key set in the dashboard.
Your friend can approve changes after signing in. Until then, changes take %1$d hours.
Ask your trusted person to scan this code. It expires after two minutes.
No changes are waiting for your trusted person.
Approved. The new rule reaches this phone in a moment.
This request was withdrawn. Nothing changed.
The change could not be applied. Ask for a new request.
The code has expired. Nothing was approved. Show a new code to try again.
Use another email address. Your helper needs a separate household.
You can show the invite code as soon as your phone connects.
Ask your friend to scan and accept this invitation. It expires after 15 minutes.
This phone cannot create an invitation right now.
Share your time limits, schedules, app choices and web filter categories. The code expires after 15 minutes.
Check the address and the version of Plainphone running on the server.
Moving to another server is allowed by the dashboard.
Moving to another server is off in the dashboard.

Copy the address, then open Settings. In Network & internet, choose Private DNS, select Private DNS provider hostname, paste the address and save. In Tailscale, turn off “Use Tailscale DNS settings”. MagicDNS names will no longer resolve.
Waiting for your phone’s filter address. Try again in a moment.
Do you use another VPN, such as Tailscale or a work VPN?
Private DNS leaves room for your other VPN. In Tailscale, turn off “Use Tailscale DNS settings”. MagicDNS names will no longer resolve.
Plainphone has been switched off. In Network & internet, change Private DNS back to Automatic to restore internet access.
In Android’s VPN settings, open Plainphone and turn off Block connections without VPN and Always-on VPN. Then return here to set up Private DNS.
In Network & internet, set Private DNS to Automatic or Off. Then return here to reconnect Plainphone VPN.

Plainphone is free today. Running it on your own server and keeping one fully protected phone on our hosted service will always be free. Later we’ll charge for additional phones on our service. We’ll tell early users well in advance.
Tap ⋮ in the top right corner.
Come back here and tap Try again.
Tap Permissions, then Location, and choose Allow all the time.
Tap Notifications and switch them on.
Location was declined, so Android no longer asks. It can only be allowed in App info.
Notifications were declined, so Android no longer asks. They can only be allowed in App info.
Not allowed this time. Tap the button to try again, or skip this for now.
If you skip this, Android may stop Plainphone in the background and protection can switch off.
If you skip this, you cannot find this phone from the dashboard.
If you skip this, the web filter can be switched off in VPN settings.
You can undo setup for %1$d minutes. Undoing switches Plainphone off without your key.
Undo after setup is off. Removing Plainphone needs your key.
Looser rules and removing Plainphone wait %1$d h.
A person you invite by QR code approves looser rules. Until they accept, changes wait %1$d h.
%1$s approves looser rules. Until they accept, changes wait %2$d h.
This invitation has expired. Show a new one.
This is an invitation, not an approval. It lets your friend become your key.
This asks your friend to review one change. Scanning is not consent: they decide after reading it.
SOS from %1$s: %2$s. Location: %3$s. Sent via Plainphone.
